description: Hotel and booking production UX update: clickable curated hotel cards, native Hotel Detail with swipe gallery/all-photos view, rating/amenities/map/room cards, room selection linked to Journey and stored booking sessions, compact Booking Detail without global wordmark, expandable outbound/return flight cards, hotel change flow through the existing iumrah Hotel Catalog, iumrah Care shortcut, and authenticated server-side booking hotel mutation/permanent D1 deletion via the existing Package Engine. No pricing rules, Flight Engine search logic, signing files, or protected workflows are changed.
